meta.title: Neon District Confrontation
meta.description: A tense standoff in a rain-soaked cyberpunk alley — 3 panels capturing approach, recognition, and tension

scene.description: Wide establishing shot of a narrow cyberpunk alley in heavy rain. Neon signs reflected in puddles. A lone figure in a long coat walks toward camera, face obscured by shadow. Towering buildings with exposed pipes, cables, and ventilation units crowd both sides.

subject.description: Tall figure in a heavy synthetic trench coat, cybernetic left arm visible at the wrist, hood up, face lost in shadow except for the glint of one augmented eye
subject.pose: walking forward, hands in coat pockets, shoulders slightly hunched against rain

environment.setting: Narrow back-alley in a megacity lower district

scene.description: Medium shot from the side. The figure has stopped. One hand pulls back the hood slightly, revealing a scarred jaw and the edge of a neural interface port behind the ear. Rain drips off the hood edge. The cybernetic arm is now fully visible — segmented chrome plates, exposed actuator cables at the elbow.

subject.description: Same figure, hood partially pulled back. Heavy scarring across jaw. Neural port with faint indicator light. Chrome prosthetic arm with visible mechanical detail — each joint, cable, plate rendered individually.
subject.pose: standing still, one hand on hood, other arm hanging — chrome fingers slightly curled

environment.setting: Same alley, tighter framing — wall textures and a broken surveillance camera visible behind

scene.description: Extreme close-up of the figure's face, straight on. The hood is off. Deep-set eyes with one clearly augmented — the iris is a mechanical aperture, micro-text etched around the rim. Rain runs down the scars. The expression shifts from controlled to something rawer — teeth slightly bared, brow furrowed. Heavy black shadows fill the eye sockets and under the cheekbones. White highlight streaks on the nose bridge and brow from overhead neon.

subject.description: Face filling the panel. Augmented right eye with mechanical iris. Deep scars crossing from left temple to chin. Short-cropped hair, wet and plastered to skull. Stubble rendered with fine dot work.
subject.expression: transition from stoic composure to barely contained fury — emotional duality in one frame

elements: neon light reflection on wet skin

scene.action: staring directly at viewer, emotional shift
